texte.Les textes du CEN et de l’ISO sont proté: The CEN and ISO texts are protected: prEN #-#, prEN #, ISO/IEC # and ISO/IEC # exist here only through their numbers and their titles. This one may be cited, translated and adapted — on three conditions the licence states itself, and that this screen honours: cite the work, and carry two notices, one for the translation, the other for the adaptation.
texte.Les treize autres référentiels de Sentin: Sentinel's thirteen other frameworks ask whether THE SYSTEM is compliant. This one asks something else: has the company identified, prevented, addressed and remedied the adverse impacts of AI — its own, and those of its business relationships, upstream and downstream. Six steps, three actor groups, and one question that commands everything: do you cause the impact, do you contribute to it, or are you only linked to it?
texte.Lisez ce qui vient de l'OCDE, ce qui vie: Read what comes from the OECD, what comes from the firm, and what the document excludes itself.
texte.Lisez les quatre-vingt-onze lignes de po: Read the ninety-one bridging rows, step by step, and the column that says whether Sentinel measures the framework opposite.
texte.Ouvrez l’étape qui vous occupe et lisez: Open the step that concerns you and read the right-hand column: it says whether Sentinel measures that framework. Of the twenty, three are measured here — the AI Act, ISO/IEC # and the NIST framework. The other seventeen are named by the OECD and not held by the firm, and the screen says so rather than presenting them as covered.

texte.Qu’il y aurait une présomption de confor: That there would be a presumption of conformity — the instrument is voluntary, and no date will change that. That it would carry a catalogue of risks — the document declares itself “risk-agnostic”. That it would cover the hardware chain — it excludes itself from that and refers to the minerals guidance.
texte.Se ranger en « lien direct » et ne rien: Filing oneself under “direct link” and doing nothing: the document writes that a direct link becomes a CONTRIBUTION if the company carries on without acting.
texte.Un cadre d’équivalence — et c’est le doc: An equivalency framework — and it is the document that writes it: “this table is not an equivalency framework, as the scope and nature of the expectations in the other frameworks may vary”. Holding ISO/IEC # does not amount to OECD due diligence, and the converse is true too.

The # practical examples come from the document; only those that one of your groups is targeted by enter the calculation.
texte.À lire les quatre-vingt-onze lignes de p: To read the ninety-one bridging rows the document gives ITSELF: for each of its six steps, the neighbouring provisions of twenty other frameworks — AI Act, DSA, CSDDD, ISO/IEC #, #, #, #, ISO #, IEEE #, the UN Guiding Principles, the NIST framework, and seven national frameworks.
texte.À poser les trois choses qui commandent: To set the three things that command all the rest: the GROUPS your organisation occupies in the AI value chain, your INVOLVEMENT in the impact, and the PRIORITISATION of the risks. The questionnaire does not know which of the # examples target you before the groups, and the level of due diligence expected at steps # and # depends on involvement.
